title: There Has NEVER Been a Better Time to Be a Builder
description:
marketwithmark.com

Ten years ago, building software meant learning to code or hiring developers.

Today? AI can help you build websites, apps, software tools, games, automations, and entire businesses faster than ever before.

The opportunity isn't just for programmers anymore. The people who win in 2026 will be the ones who learn how to direct AI and turn ideas into reality.

If you've ever wanted to build something, now is the time.

top_reply.text:
Let me get this straight: having an idea and using AI to bring it to life isn't creative?

Then architects aren't creative because they use CAD software, and builders aren't creative because they use power tools.

Creativity is turning ideas into reality. AI is just another tool.

The builders get this. The spectators don't.
